_comment: Tests Node 6c family member name confirmation, premature execute guard, correct OUTPUT CONTRACT after success, and CONSTRAINT PIVOT silence.

scenarios.name: Agent asks for CALLER's name instead of family member's name

history.content: I'd like to book for my son Jake.
Just to confirm, I'll book this for Jake — is that right?
Yes, that's right.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent proceeds to step 2 (builds payload silently) then step 3 — speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with booking_for='other', patient_name='Jake' (from {{family_member_name}}). FAIL if: agent asks 'And what's your name?' or asks for the caller's own name instead of proceeding to execute.

scenarios.name: Premature execute before step 1 confirmation received

history.content: Book it for my daughter Mia.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks 'Just to confirm, I'll book this for Mia — is that right?' with no tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' before the family member name is confirmed.

scenarios.name: Step 3 success — spoken message + wrap_up in same turn

history.content: Yes that's right.
Checking that now, one moment.
[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Your appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen for Jake."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks 'Your appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen for Jake.' verbatim AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' in the same turn, with no additional words or questions appended. FAIL if: agent appends 'Is there anything else?' or fails to call universal_router wrap_up in the same turn.

scenarios.name: CONSTRAINT PIVOT during confirmation — caller changes time silently

history.content: Actually, can we do a different time? Tuesday doesn't work for us.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='change_time' (or 'constraint_change' — check actual edge label), in the same turn. FAIL if: agent asks the step 1 confirmation question first, omits the filler phrase, or speaks anything beyond the single filler phrase before routing.

scenarios.name: BLOCKING SIGNAL 1 — cancel intent during confirmation overrides booking flow

history.content: Actually, I want to cancel instead — I'm not feeling well.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set AND calls universal_router intent='cancel_intent', in the same turn, without completing the booking. FAIL if: agent asks the family member confirmation question first, calls smart_voice_agent intent='book', or omits the filler phrase.

scenarios.name: WAITLIST OFFER FOLLOW-UP — booking success with waitlist_offer_pending; agent must HALT not wrap_up

history.content: Yes that's right.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "waitlist_offer_pending": true, "message": "Jake's appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks 'Jake's appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?' verbatim and HALTS — does NOT call universal_router intent='wrap_up' this turn. FAIL if: agent calls wrap_up this turn (must wait for caller's answer via Signal 0.5). FAIL if: agent appends any additional words or questions beyond the message field.

scenarios.name: Signal 0.5 WAITLIST OFFER FOLLOW-UP — caller accepts; waitlist_add + wrap_up in same turn

history.content: Yes that's right.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "waitlist_offer_pending": true, "message": "Jake's appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?"}
Jake's appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?
Yes please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls universal_router intent='waitlist_add' with patient_name={{family_member_name}}, booking_for='other', requested_date={{appointment_date}}, and (once result returns) speaks result message then calls universal_router intent='wrap_up'. FAIL if: agent calls wrap_up without calling waitlist_add. FAIL if: payload omits requested_date.

scenarios.name: Signal 0.5 WAITLIST OFFER FOLLOW-UP — caller declines; wrap_up without waitlist_add

history.content: Yes that's right.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "waitlist_offer_pending": true, "message": "Jake's appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?"}
Jake's appointment is confirmed for Monday at 2pm with Dr Chen. Would you like me to also add them to the waitlist in case something sooner comes up?
No thanks, we're fine.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' in this turn WITHOUT calling waitlist_add. FAIL if: agent calls waitlist_add (caller declined). FAIL if: agent asks another question instead of calling wrap_up.
